title: Text clarity: no spill-over, crisper rendering, readable sizes
changes: KPI cards and hero scale their content with the screen height, so sub-labels and the baseline value no longer cross the card edge (previously 2-18px at 1366x768, 1440x900 and 1914x912)
A locked goal field now spans two grid rows, so the solver select and its feedback no longer overlap the next field
Removed permanent will-change layers and fractional hover scales/filters from text containers to avoid blurry text
Light text on the accent hero is more opaque and the hero gradient is subtler, improving contrast
Minimum text size raised from 9-10px to 10.5-11px for limits, chart captions, legends, tool buttons and status lines
Computed number inputs show at most two decimals (30.42 instead of 30.4166666)
